name: St. Regis Venice
positioning: The St. Regis Venice, a Grand Canal hotel across four interconnected palazzi in San Marco, with a garden and a contemporary art collection
best_for: Travelers who want Grand Canal views facing Santa Maria della Salute
Art lovers drawn to contemporary art and Venetian glass
Families needing connecting rooms or multi-bedroom suites

facts.text: The hotel sits on the Grand Canal, with views across the city's landmarks.
The hotel has stood in its spot on the Grand Canal for over a century and a half.
The former Westin Europa and Regina was reinvented as the St. Regis Venice in 2019.
The hotel spreads across four interconnected palazzi.
A garden lies between the hotel's two canal-facing wings.
The art collection includes works by Olivier Masmonteil, Jaume Plensa and Lorenzo Quinn.
Gio's restaurant is named after San Giorgio Island, just across the canal.
The Monet Room is a private dining room inside Gio's that seats up to ten.
Arts Bar serves cocktails created to celebrate masterpieces of art.
St. Regis Butler service is available to all guests of the hotel.
A private jewelry workshop with Venetian artist Valeria Boncompagni teaches lost wax casting.
Multi-bedroom suites and connecting rooms are offered for family travel.

highlights.text: Ai Weiwei's White Chandelier hangs in the Gran Salone, part of a glass collaboration with Berengo Studio.
Claude Monet was a former guest of the hotel, and the Monet Suites are inspired by his Venetian paintings.
The bar's signature Bloody Mary, Santa Maria, is named after the basilica just in front of the bar.
The hotel faces the basilica of Santa Maria della Salute at close range.
The Ginori Terrace was created in collaboration with the porcelain house Ginori 1735.

considerations.text: The street toward St. Mark's Square near the hotel is very touristy.
The hotel does not offer on-site parking.
Gio's restaurant is closed from 7 to 29 January.
